name: Automatic App Release
description: Describes how to create a new release for this application.
—
 
* Use standard semver without “v” e.g. 1.0.0
* Update CHANGELOG.md
* Run tests
* Build the project
* Ensure you’ve not missed the cargo.lock
custom_skills.name: release-automatic

custom_skills.content:
---
name: check-agents-for-updates
description: Scan all available LLMs that this application supports and look for updates.
---

This project supports a range of LLMs for coding, documented in src-tauri/src/agent.

These products routinely add new features and change existing behaviours.

This task is to walk through these agents one by one, check their current support for our features on their official documentation on the internet against our implemented versions, and flag any gaps or changes required.

You may add additional documentation into the docs folder to support this.
custom_skills.name: check-agents-for-updates
